name: HubSpot

tiers.how: Sage connects to HubSpot via the HubSpot v3 REST API using a Private App token stored in the OS credential store. The owner must create a Private App in HubSpot Settings, grant the required scopes (contacts, deals, emails), and store the token via setup_creds. Private App tokens do not expire. Reads are free; writes require approval.
always_tap: any outbound email or sequence enrollment
any contact merge or permanent deletion

gotchas: Private App tokens do not expire but scopes are fixed at creation; delete and recreate the app to add new scopes.
HubSpot's email send API (Marketing Hub) requires a Marketing Hub subscription; verify the account tier before building email sends.
HubSpot's API rate limit is 110 requests per 10 seconds per app; batch reads where possible.
HubSpot's free CRM and paid Marketing/Sales Hubs have different API surface areas; confirm which features are available on the account tier.
notes: HubSpot is a full-featured CRM and marketing platform best suited to businesses with a structured sales pipeline and email marketing needs.
